rules.fusion: adjacent fusion cells; same colour stays same, mixed colours produce third-colour split
rules.brood: mother stays; daughters fill a connected empty route serially; parent becomes Fusion
rules.destruct: source and connected target are both removed
rules.imitation: copies the role of a connected same-colour cell; colour is preserved
